title: M2S-Bench Protocol B view-menu declaration
description: Schema for declaring purchasable evidence views, their free fields, paid fields, costs, dependencies, and frozen scorers.

slice_id.description: Benchmark slice, e.g. dense-semantic, compression-ladder, ce-purchase, 2wiki-structured, or controlled-diagnostic.

allowed_tiers.description: Visibility tiers accepted by this menu.

default_cost_menu.description: Default declared cost-menu id for official scoring.

accepted_cost_menus.description: Additional declared cost-menu ids accepted by the validator for rescoring profiles.

secondary_cost_menus.description: Paths to non-default cost-menu files that reuse this view menu.

visible_fields.description: Fields visible before this view is bought.

paid_fields.description: Fields materialized only when this view is bought.

forbidden_before_purchase.description: Evaluator-only fields that fail validation if present before purchase.

parents.description: Declared dependency views for cumulative-cost profiles.

hidden_evaluator_fields.description: Canonical slice-level evaluator-held fields. These fields must not appear in submissions unless a slice explicitly declares a paid materialization rule.
